display_name: LoRa W24 固定幅度方向分支的 CPU 源域评测接续
description: Evaluate the original r01 terminal head without training; fix archival SciPy complex128 aperture serialization and retain the identical source matrix.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA performance research goal.

code.environment: Pinned W24 CPU runtime, no GPU. Exact original r01 terminal checkpoint.
code.cwd: Owned evaluator release controller; pinned W24 archive for source-only smoke and score.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: Exactly the r01 Practical U pair bank and original r02 carve (20,000 fit, 500 held). Same registered V panel of 300 distinct physical packets for each Full view.
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Reuse VALIDATED_ONCE lora_full_packets_v1 registered V order and true E104.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Evaluation-only CPU source V with E104 after r01 terminal freeze. No retraining, target, or change to selection.

checkpoint.initialization: Reuse r01 direction.pt and metadata at source step 24,000, no fit in r02.

sources.role: Exact terminal frozen 24,000 update direction head and original optimizer budget.
Fixed source-only Practical exact-additive 24000 update checkpoint for both readouts.
Independent source evaluation after direction checkpoint freeze.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact r01 current terminal checkpoint, original parent, E104 readout, 300 source V IDs and endpoint parity.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen parent of the same LoRa source contract; original source-only checkpoint
checkpoint.selection_rule: Last of 24000 steps, then fixed source V score. Promote eligibility only if six at least +18 vs frozen half, low urban at least +6, clean >= raw and receiver-stratified six-scene 95% lower net >0. Any formal launch after source qualification is registered separately.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, zero GPU; waits for existing r01 terminal checkpoint, two inference and two replay workers.
execution.stop_rule: Missing invalid terminal fit proof, source contract or CPU real-checkpoint smoke, prediction closure or scoring failure. Existing GPU fit preserved.

rows.method: One full-packet phase and IQ direction head with separate hard pre-RMS center and edge norms
rows.seed_notes: New source fit seed 2026112991; registered V panel and Full draw; independent E104 seed 2026092702.
rows.budget_ref: No fit in r02, same r01 terminal state. 300 source V packets x seven views x three rows.

notes: R01 fitting logic, parent, optimizer, predictions on the existing formal task, and promotion criteria remain unchanged.
The original evaluator reinterpreted complex128 aperture differences as complex64 and expanded the sample axis. r02 converts dtype before the byte view.
Read-only real U probe on N607 verified exact CPU raw/half parity and pre-scale norm relative errors below 1e-6. Both existing controllers are independent.
